flow: 封面：单元大标题 + 课时 + 教师署名 + 主题配图（海牛/环保图）
学习目标：3 条目标（阅读技能 / 重点结构 / 节能建议表达），编号 1-2-3
人物导入：介绍 Amy Winterbourne，用大问号 'What makes her unusual?' 制造悬念
图片切入：Her house makes her unusual. It is made from trash.（点题句）
主题呈现：It is a house of trash 垃圾屋!（作品感标题页）
阅读 Task 1：快速阅读，判断 T/F（扫读策略）
阅读 Task 2：细读回答问题（寻读策略）
听力 Task 3：听音填表（屋顶/栅栏/旧电视等信息点）
阅读 Task 4：朗读并提问，引出 Key Structures
语法小结：make/build A out of B；be made from/of/in/by/into 辨析
Exercise 1：选词填空 from/of/in/by/into
Exercise 2：选择正确答案（含交际语境）
意义追问：Why does Amy want to recycle the trash?（节能/环保/拯救地球）
讨论：What can we do to save energy? 提供句型支架 A/B 对话
写作任务：以 How we should save energy 为题写 80 词短文（含要点提示/连接词支架）
写作示范页：提供 First/Second/At last 等连接词框架
Summary：Key structures 总结
Summary：Conjunctions 连接词 + How to save energy 行动清单
情感升华：Let's try our best to save energy and protect our home.
名人名言/谚语：Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today. Take action now!
Homework：必做（写作）+ 选做
致谢：Thanks for listening!

objectives: To practice reading skills.（练习阅读技能）
To learn some important structures.（学习重要句型结构）
To give advice on saving energy.（学会给出节能建议）
teaching_process: Lead-in：问题导入 + 悬念设问
Reading Task 1 扫读 T/F → Task 2 寻读问答 → Task 3 听读填表 → Task 4 朗读质疑
语言聚焦：从文本中提炼 make/build A out of B 与 be made from/of/in/by/into
练习巩固：选词填空 + 选择填空（由词到句、由机械到交际）
意义探究：Why recycle? → Discussion 节能讨论（句型支架）
输出写作：80 词短文 'How we should save energy'（要点 + 连接词支架）
总结升华：Key structures + Conjunctions + 行动清单 + 名言激励
作业分层：必做（写作）+ 选做

key_structures.make_build_A_out_of_B: make/build A out of B（用 B 制造/建造 A）

be_made.from: 看不出原材料的制成品（Bread is made from corn.）
be_made.of: 看得出原材料的制成品（The skirt is made of silk.）
be_made.in: 产地（These cars are made in Japan.）
be_made.by: 制作人（be made by sb. 由……制作）
be_made.into: 转化关系（be made into ... 制成……）

examples: The skirt is made of silk.
These cars are made in Japan.

task_1.label: Task 1 · 快速阅读扫读
task_1.instruction: Read the article quickly and write 'T' or 'F'.（快速阅读，判断 T/F）

task_2.label: Task 2 · 细读寻读
task_2.instruction: Read carefully and answer the questions.（细读回答问题）

items.a: She lives in a house that she built herself out of trash.

items.q: What does Amy make out of old TVs?
items.a: She makes model toys out of old TVs and sells them to raise money for the Children's Hospital.
He is the president of the Help Save Our Planet Society.
She is an inspiration to people.

task_3.instruction: Listen and fill in the chart.（听音填写信息表）

task_4.label: Task 4 · 朗读质疑
task_4.instruction: Read aloud and raise your questions.（朗读并提出疑问）

exercise_1.label: Exercise 1 · 选词填空
exercise_1.instruction: Complete the sentences with from / of / in / by / into.

exercise_2.label: Exercise 2 · 选择填空
exercise_2.instruction: Choose the correct answers.（交际语境选择）
exercise_2.example: --Your dress looks very nice. What is it made ____? --Silk, and it is made ____ Wuhan. (A. from; in ...)

discussion.title: What can we do to save energy?
model: A: ..., what can we do to save energy in daily life?
A: I agree/disagree with you. I think ...

writing_task.title: Writing Task
writing_task.requirement: 写一篇 80 词左右的短文，谈谈对节约能源的看法，以及日常生活中的节能措施（3 点建议）
scaffold: At first/First of all, ... What's more, ... Last but not least, ...

summary.key_structures: make/build A out of B；be made from/of/in/by/into
summary.conjunctions: First, ... Second/Next/Then, ... At last, ... / First of all, ... What's more, ... Last but not the least, ...
how_to_save_energy: collect empty bottles and waste paper
take a bus or ride a bike

lines: Let's try our best to save energy and protect our home.
Saving energy is important to us.
Never put off till tomorrow what you can do today.（今日事今日毕）
